metadata.title: About
metadata.description: Learn about utils.live - our mission to make developer tools accessible, fast, and privacy-focused.

hero.heading: Developer tools that respect your time
hero.description: utils.live was born from frustration with slow, ad-filled, and privacy-invasive online tools. We built what we wanted to use: fast, free, and respectful utilities.

speedFirst.title: Speed First
speedFirst.description: Tools should be instant. Our client-side tools run in your browser for zero latency.

privacyByDesign.title: Privacy by Design
privacyByDesign.description: Your data stays on your device. We don't track, store, or analyze your tool inputs.

developerExperience.title: Developer Experience
developerExperience.description: Built by developers, for developers. Every tool is designed to save you time.

freeAccessible.title: Free & Accessible
freeAccessible.description: Core tools are free forever. We believe everyone should have access to quality utilities.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.description: We believe developer tools should be accessible to everyone, regardless of budget or technical expertise. utils.live provides professional-grade utilities without the bloat, tracking, or paywalls. Our goal is to help you focus on what matters: building great software.

team.heading: Built with care
team.description: utils.live is maintained by a small team of passionate developers who use these tools daily. We're always adding new tools and improving existing ones based on community feedback.

metadata.title: Contact
